data.gender_notes: Mafiya is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who possesses great power and strength. Derived from the Sanskrit word 'maha' meaning great and 'viya' meaning force, this name signifies a person who is strong and powerful in all aspects of life. The name Mafiya carries the meaning “Powerful, Strong” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Hindi. Parents who choose Mafiya usually hope their child will grow to embody powerful, strong and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.cultural_impact: In popular culture, the name 'Mafiya' is most famously associated with the Russian mafia due to its similarity in pronunciation with the Russian word for mafia, 'mafiya'. However, in India, the name holds no such negative connotation. Instead, it embodies the strength, fearlessness, and power that one aspires to in life.
data.spiritual_significance: In Hindu mythology, the god Shiva is often referred to as 'Mahadev' or 'Mahavishnu', which translates to 'the great god'. The name 'Mafiya' comes from the same root, emphasizing the divine qualities of strength, power, and fearlessness. It also symbolizes the power of the individual to overcome obstacles, achieve their goals, and fulfill their potential in life.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mafiya, in Sanskrit, means 'one who has vanquished fear'. This name signifies courage, bravery, and fearlessness in the face of adversity. It is a reminder to face challenges with determination and strength.
